summary.tldr: Requires menstrual tampon labels to list the substances they contain, and brings the change into force 18 months after royal assent.
what_it_does: Requires labels on menstrual tampons to include a list of the substances they contain, under the Food and Drugs Act.
Sets the bill to come into force 18 months after royal assent.
summary.background: The bill amends the Food and Drugs Act, which already sets labelling rules for devices.
